release: Davonium Technologies V51 — Studio UI Redesign and Compact DVNM Bot
source: Davonium-Technologies-V48-Immersive-Final-Release.zip plus prior V49/V50 module/control work and the V51 design revision
scope: A new visual-system layer across the existing website, separate visual identities for five core demos, and a smaller procedural Three.js bot that glows and animates its mouth while user-initiated speech is active where supported. Existing content/routes are preserved. This report does not claim full completion of every advanced item in either prompt.

The 100,000 particle count is an optional capacity profile, not a measured performance result or FPS guarantee.
Speech boundary events vary by browser; no microphone capture is provided or implied.
Physical-device, screen-reader, Lighthouse/Web Vitals, slow-network and production-route browser checks remain outstanding.
